triage.note: gates-2026-08-22 T5-3: boundary_hygiene re-applied a COPY of the heading regex over offsets the real regex (segment.HEADING_RE) produced, and the copy had drifted — HEADING_RE allows an optional space between the item number and its letter ('Item 9 A.'), the copy (`item\s*9A\b`) did not. So the one heading shape the two disagreed on was a false positive: the item is located correctly, then warned against and docked 0.15 for opening with the very heading that located it. The fix reuses HEADING_RE instead of a copy, which makes the layer-consistency assertion ADR-016 §2 keeps it for unable to drift again. ADR-011's IBR extension and INV-S1's enforcement list are untouched: the check still runs over every span-carrying item.
